meta.title: Primary — cutting a design system from 214 components to 38
meta.description: Conference talk by the team behind Primary, the design system of the Tally banking app: why 214 components slowed nine teams, how three token layers replaced them, what the cut cost and what we would change.

slides.eyebrow: Primary design system · Systems Week Berlin · 4 December 2026
slides.heading: We cut 176 components and shipped twice as fast.
slides.lead: Ines Vogel, design systems lead, Tally

slides.heading: Nine product teams had built 31 different primary buttons
slides.imageAlt: Nine team columns, each with its own mismatched button styles in red, blue, yellow and black
slides.notes: Let the picture land. Ask the room how many primary buttons their own product has.

slides.body:
Base tokens hold values.
Role tokens hold meaning.
Components only read roles.

slides.heading: What did we cut, and how?
Components fell 82% while system coverage rose to 96%
slides.notes: 5.4 days against 11.2 is the 'twice as fast' on the cover. Same Jira query, same definition.

slides.heading: One role file now themes every Tally product
The cut cost two quarters and froze new UI for six weeks
We would cut in month one, not after migrating 214 parts
slides.body:
We migrated parts we later deleted.
Cutting first would have saved about 9 weeks.

slides.heading: Cut components first and your teams will ship twice as fast
slides.lead: Our audit script and codemods are open source.
slides.notes: Repeat the cover line in the last sentence you say. Then take questions.
